summary: Transform OccuHealth landing page from US HIPAA-focused to UK GDPR-compliant messaging. Updates compliance badges, feature cards, testimonials brand name, adds missing Pricing and HowItWorks sections, and removes non-functional buttons.

phases.name: Critical Compliance (HIPAA to GDPR)
phases.description: Replace all HIPAA references with GDPR compliance messaging across hero, features, and footer components

subtasks.description: Update HeroSection.tsx: Change 'HIPAA Compliant Platform' badge to 'GDPR Compliant Platform', update stats from '500+ providers' to 'UK-wide network'
acceptanceCriteria: Stats reference UK, not US nationwide

subtasks.description: Update FeaturesSection.tsx: Replace 'HIPAA Compliant' feature card with 'GDPR Compliant' card, update description to UK data protection, add Employer Portal and Doctor Portal feature cards
acceptanceCriteria: GDPR Compliant feature card exists with UK data protection description
Employer Portal card explains booking and report access
Doctor Portal card explains schedule and report management

subtasks.description: Update Footer.tsx: Replace 'HIPAA Compliant' with 'GDPR Compliant', add 'UK Data Protection Act' reference

phases.gateCondition: All 3 compliance subtasks complete with no HIPAA references remaining

phases.name: Brand Consistency
phases.description: Fix brand name references and update CTA messaging

subtasks.description: Update TestimonialsSection.tsx: Replace all 3 'MedReport Pro' references with 'OccuHealth'
Update CTASection.tsx: Update brand messaging to align with OccuHealth UK GDPR platform identity
acceptanceCriteria: CTA messaging aligned with UK GDPR platform

phases.gateCondition: All brand references consistent with OccuHealth UK platform

phases.name: New Sections Creation
phases.description: Create missing PricingSection and HowItWorksSection components

subtasks.description: CREATE PricingSection.tsx: Contact-only pricing with 3 options (One-off assessments, Subscription packages, Custom retainer). Include id='pricing' for nav anchor. No prices shown - all 'Contact for pricing' with 'Get in Touch' CTA button.
acceptanceCriteria: Section has id='pricing' for nav anchor
Get in Touch CTA button present

subtasks.description: CREATE HowItWorksSection.tsx: 6-step workflow showing employer/doctor journey. Steps: 1) Employer creates account, 2) Employer books appointment, 3) Doctor reviews info, 4) Video consultation, 5) Doctor compiles report, 6) Report delivered to employer portal.
acceptanceCriteria: Steps explain employer and doctor workflow

phases.gateCondition: Both new section files created and export properly

phases.name: Integration
phases.description: Update exports and integrate new sections into landing page

subtasks.description: Update src/components/landing/index.ts: Add exports for PricingSection and HowItWorksSection
Update src/App.tsx LandingPage function: Import and add HowItWorksSection between Features and Testimonials, add PricingSection after Testimonials
acceptanceCriteria: Section order: Hero > Features > HowItWorks > Testimonials > Pricing > CTA

phases.gateCondition: All sections render on landing page without errors

phases.name: Cleanup

subtasks.description: Update CTASection.tsx: Remove 'Schedule a Call' button (non-functional)
acceptanceCriteria: No 'Schedule a Call' button in component

phases.gateCondition: No non-functional buttons remain on landing page

phases.name: Validation
phases.description: Browser testing to verify all changes render correctly

subtasks.description: Browser validation: Navigate to landing page, verify GDPR compliance text, verify brand consistency, verify new sections visible, verify no HIPAA or MedReport Pro text
acceptanceCriteria: Pricing section visible with anchor working

phases.gateCondition: All visual and functional checks pass

risks.description: LandingPage function location may differ from expected App.tsx
risks.mitigation: Verified LandingPage is defined in src/App.tsx via symbol analysis

risks.description: New section styling may not match existing design system
risks.mitigation: Use FeaturesSection.tsx as reference for styling patterns

risks.description: Nav anchor #pricing may not scroll correctly if section ID missing
risks.mitigation: Explicitly require id='pricing' in acceptance criteria

risks.description: Typecheck failures after new file creation
risks.mitigation: Run typecheck after each phase, fix immediately
